lesson.subject: science
lesson.title: Trees and Flowering Plants
lesson.summary: Trees and flowers around us: their parts, their kinds and how they change with the seasons.
learning_objectives: Name parts of a tree and of a flowering plant
Tell evergreen and deciduous trees apart
Name some wild and garden plants

standards.text: Identify and name common wild and garden plants, including deciduous and evergreen trees; describe the basic structure of common flowering plants, including trees

success_criteria: I can name parts of a tree
I can say if a tree is evergreen or deciduous
I can name some wild and garden plants
lesson.real_life: Oak, pine and daisies in the UK, and neem, mango, shisham and sarson fields in Pakistan, with neem trees giving shade by schools and mosques.

blocks.markdown: Today's big question: what are the parts of a tree?
blocks.say: Today we meet trees and flowers. What are their parts called?

blocks.text: Stop 1: Trunk, branches, roots and leaves

scenes.caption: Trunk.
scenes.say: The trunk is the thick middle. It holds the tree up.

scenes.caption: Branches and leaves.
scenes.say: Branches grow out from the trunk. Leaves grow on the branches.

scenes.caption: Roots.
scenes.say: Roots grow under the ground. They take in water and hold the tree.

question.prompt: Which part of a tree holds it up?
question.explanation: The trunk holds the tree up.

blocks.markdown: **Bark** is the tough skin of a tree.
blocks.say: Some people think trees are not plants. But trees are plants, just very big ones.

scenes.caption: Bark.

scenes.caption: Leaves.
scenes.say: Leaves catch sunlight. A tree uses it to make food.

scenes.caption: Small and tall.
scenes.say: Trees can be small or very tall. A young tree is still a tree.

blocks.title: A walk with Zainab
blocks.transcript: Zainab goes for a walk. She will visit three plants. First is an oak tree. Its leaves are green in summer. In autumn, the oak leaves turn gold and fall down. In winter the oak is bare. It is only resting. Next is a pine tree. Its needles stay green all year. Then a meadow of wildflowers. Nobody planted them. A bee visits a flower for sweet nectar. Zainab watches quietly. Zainab draws what she saw. She did not pick a single flower.
blocks.caption: A child spots which leaves fall and which stay on a seasonal walk.
